description: This PHP class 'DateTimeHelperService' provides various date and time utility functions, including formatting dates, comparing dates, calculating date differences, generating date ranges, and handling time zones within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: A service class for handling date and time operations such as formatting, comparison, range generation, and timezone management.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to 'Y-m-d' string or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' string based on the withSeconds parameter.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a time string in 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two DateTime objects represent the same date, with an option to accept nulls.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates an array of DateTime objects between two dates with a specified interval.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime, optionally in a specified timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeZone object based on a float offset.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on system configuration or defaults to 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date and week start index.
